name: tarkov-price-hover
description: Overlay Windows affichant le prix des items d'Escape from Tarkov au survol (OCR + API tarkov.dev). Usage personnel.
author: personal

scripts.test: npm run test:match && npm run test:ocr
scripts.test:ocr: npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --entry dist/tools/ocr-selftest.js
scripts.test:failures: npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --entry dist/tools/failure-selftest.js
scripts.test:region: npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --entry dist/tools/region-selftest.js
scripts.test:icons: npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --entry dist/tools/icon-selftest.js
scripts.test:grid: npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --entry dist/tools/grid-selftest.js
